meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: Common questions about readykare — healthcare staffing for facilities and professionals in Canada.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about how readykare works for healthcare teams and professionals.

items.question: What is readykare?
items.answer: readykare connects Canadian healthcare facilities with pre-screened, credentialed professionals for temporary staffing, home care, and relief coverage. We focus on fast matching and compliance so you can fill shifts without long hiring cycles.

items.question: Who can use readykare?
items.answer: Healthcare organizations, facilities, and families can post staffing needs. Licensed and credentialed professionals (nurses, PSWs, allied health, and more) can create a profile and apply to opportunities that match their skills and availability.

items.question: How does matching work?
items.answer: Facilities describe the role, dates, and requirements. We surface candidates from our vetted pool based on credentials, experience, and availability. Workers can also browse and apply to open roles that fit their preferences.

items.question: Is there a cost to create an account?
items.answer: You can create an account and explore the platform at no upfront cost. Only pay for the shifts you cover.

items.question: How are credentials verified?
items.answer: We collect and verify professional licenses, certifications, and other requirements according to your role and provincial rules. Exact steps are shown during onboarding so you always know what's needed.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: We handle personal information in line with Canadian privacy law (including PIPEDA where applicable). We only share what's necessary for placements, and you can read more in our Privacy Policy.

items.question: Do you operate outside Ontario?
items.answer: We're focused on Ontario healthcare staffing today. If you're elsewhere in Canada, you can still reach out — we'll let you know when coverage expands.

items.question: How do I get help?
items.answer: Use the contact options in the footer or email us at support@readykare.com. For account-specific issues, sign in and use in-app support where available.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How readykare collects, uses, and protects personal information for temporary healthcare staffing in Canada.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: A short, plain-language summary of how readykare handles personal information as we match healthcare facilities with temporary staff.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: ReadyKare Inc. ("ReadyKare", "we", "us") runs a temporary healthcare staffing platform that matches Canadian healthcare facilities with pre-screened, credentialed professionals.

This policy explains what personal information we collect, what we do with it, and the rights you have. We handle personal information in line with Canadian privacy law, including PIPEDA and applicable provincial equivalents.

sections.title: What we collect

groups.heading: From professionals
bullets: Name, contact details, and location
Credentials, licenses, and relevant work history
Availability and shift preferences
Payroll details needed to pay you

groups.heading: From facilities
bullets: Organization details and authorized contacts
Staffing requests (role, dates, requirements)
Billing and invoicing information

groups.heading: From visitors
bullets: Basic technical data (IP, browser, pages visited)
Anything you voluntarily share in a form or email

sections.note: We only collect what we need to run the platform and staff shifts.

sections.title: How we use it
bullets: Verify credentials and eligibility to work
Match professionals with facility requests
Coordinate schedules, placements, and payroll
Respond to questions and provide support
Meet our legal and regulatory obligations

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share only what's necessary: with facilities to confirm a placement, with regulators or colleges to verify credentials, and with trusted service providers (payroll, background checks, hosting) acting on our behalf under confidentiality terms.
We disclose information to authorities when required by law or a valid legal process.
sections.note: We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable, industry-standard safeguards — encryption in transit, access controls, and secure hosting — proportionate to the sensitivity of the data.
If a breach occurs that poses a real risk of significant harm, we will notify you and the appropriate authorities.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can access, correct, or delete your personal information and withdraw consent where it applies.
Email support@readykare.com and we will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information for as long as we need it to provide our services and to meet legal or tax obligations, then securely delete or anonymize it.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: As ReadyKare grows, this policy may change. We will update the "last updated" date and, for material changes, notify you directly.

terms.subtitle: The plain-language ground rules for using ReadyKare, whether you're a healthcare professional picking up shifts or a facility requesting staff.

sections.title: Your agreement with us
paragraphs: These Terms govern your use of readykare.com and our staffing services (the "Services"). By using the Services, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
If you are accepting on behalf of an organization, you confirm you have authority to bind it. If you don't agree to these Terms, please don't use the Services.

sections.title: What we do
paragraphs: ReadyKare is a temporary healthcare staffing platform. We help Canadian facilities fill shifts with pre-screened, credentialed professionals, and we help those professionals find suitable placements.
We match, coordinate, and (where applicable) handle payroll for the placements we arrange.

sections.title: Your account
bullets: Give us accurate, up-to-date information
Keep your login credentials secure
You're responsible for activity on your account

sections.title: For professionals
bullets: Hold and maintain valid credentials for the work you accept
Follow the policies, procedures, and professional standards of the facility you're placed in
Let us know right away if your licence, availability, or eligibility changes
Don't use ReadyKare to circumvent placements (e.g. soliciting direct hire from a facility you met through us)

sections.title: For facilities
bullets: Give accurate details about the shift, setting, and any known hazards
Follow applicable health and safety laws for staff working on your site
Pay invoices on the terms set out in your agreement with us

sections.title: Acceptable use
bullets: No false, misleading, or fraudulent submissions
No unauthorized access, scraping, or automated abuse
No conduct that undermines the safety or integrity of the platform

sections.title: Stripe Services Agreement
sections.html: Payment processing services for healthcare professionals and facilities on ReadyKare are provided by Stripe and are subject to the Stripe Connected Account Agreement, which includes the Stripe Terms of Service (collectively, the “Stripe Services Agreement”). By agreeing to these Terms of Use or continuing to operate as a healthcare professional or facility on ReadyKare, you agree to be bound by the Stripe Services Agreement, as the same might be modified by Stripe from time to time. As a condition of ReadyKare enabling payment processing services through Stripe, you agree to provide ReadyKare accurate and complete information about you and your business, and you authorize ReadyKare to share it and transaction information related to your use of the payment processing services provided by Stripe.

sections.title: Disclaimers & limits
paragraphs: We make reasonable efforts to screen professionals and to fill requests, but we don't guarantee placements or specific outcomes.
Clinical decisions during a shift remain the professional responsibility of the individual and the facility. ReadyKare is not a clinical care provider.
sections.note: To the extent permitted by law, ReadyKare's total liability in connection with the Services is limited to the fees you've paid us in the three months before the claim.

sections.title: Changes & termination
paragraphs: We may update these Terms as the platform evolves. We'll post the revised date and, for material changes, notify you directly.
We may also suspend or end access for anyone who misuses the Services.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Ontario.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms? Email support@readykare.com.

meta.title: AI Candidate Screening
meta.description: ReadyKare runs structured AI interviews on every applicant and delivers a ranked shortlist — skip the scheduling, no-shows, and guesswork.
meta.ogDescription: From open role to hired in days. AI-powered screening that never sleeps.

hero.subtitle: We run structured AI interviews on every applicant and deliver a ranked shortlist — so you skip the scheduling, the no-shows, and the gut-feel guesswork.

pain.title: Manual hiring is broken.
pain.tagline: Every step that depends on a human calendar is a bottleneck you can't afford.

items.title: Hours lost to phone screens
items.body: First-round calls that go nowhere eat the majority of every recruiter's week — time that should be spent on the people who actually made the cut.

items.title: No-shows and late reschedules
items.body: A booked slot is not a kept slot. Every ghost knocks your timeline back by days, and the next available time is never soon enough.

items.title: Inconsistent evaluations
items.body: Different interviewers ask different questions. Without a structured benchmark, you're comparing apples to opinions — not to candidates.

how.subtitle: You tell us what you need. We take care of everything in between.

steps.title: Describe the role
steps.body: Tell us who you're looking for — the position, the must-haves, and what success looks like in the first 90 days.

steps.title: We handle the rest
steps.body: Every applicant goes through our rigorous screening process on their own time. No calendar coordination required from you.

steps.title: Meet your shortlist
steps.body: Within 48 hours, you receive a curated shortlist of candidates who have already proven they meet your bar — ready for your final conversation.

candidate.subtitle: A frictionless experience means more candidates finish — which means you see more of the talent pool, not just the ones who cleared a scheduling hurdle.

perks.title: On their schedule
perks.body: Candidates complete screening whenever it suits them — no interview slots to juggle, no drop-offs from scheduling conflicts.

perks.title: Under 20 minutes
perks.body: A focused, structured process that respects their time and keeps completion rates high.

perks.title: Any device, anywhere
perks.body: Phone, tablet, laptop — wherever they are, the experience works seamlessly.

perks.title: Always open
perks.body: Your pipeline keeps moving around the clock. No waiting for office hours to receive applicants.

cta.title: Ready to fill your role?
cta.subtitle: Post your opening today and receive a shortlist of qualified, pre-screened candidates within 48 hours.

hero.title: Hire smarter, not harder.
hero.subtitle: Structured AI interviews on every applicant. A ranked shortlist delivered — no scheduling, no guesswork.

free.name: Free
free.description: Try AI screening with no commitment.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For teams that hire at scale.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI screening.

items.a: Candidates receive an invite link and complete a structured video or text interview. Our AI asks consistent, role-specific questions, evaluates every response, and returns a ranked shortlist with clear reasoning — no human scheduler required.

items.q: Can I customize the interview questions?
items.a: On the Pro plan you can add your own questions on top of the AI-generated set. On Free and Starter, our AI generates optimized questions from the role title, description, and requirements you provide.
A candidate is anyone who receives a screening invite. Each invite counts toward your plan limit regardless of whether the candidate completes the interview.

items.q: What happens when I reach my plan limits?
items.a: You will receive a notification before hitting your limits. You can upgrade at any time and the remaining cost is prorated to your next billing date.
Identity verification is available on Starter and Pro plans. It confirms that candidates are who they say they are before you invest time reviewing their interview results.

items.q: Can I cancel or change plans at any time?
items.a: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel from your billing settings at any time. Annual plan cancellations retain full access until the end of the paid billing period.

staffing.title: Transparent, demand-driven rates.
staffing.subtitle: Every request is priced in real time based on your profession, shift details, and regional demand — so you always know what you're paying before you confirm.

factors.label: Profession & experience
factors.detail: Each healthcare role has a regulated base rate. Workers with more experience sit in higher tiers, reflected in the quoted rate.

factors.label: Shift timing
factors.detail: Overnight and early-morning shifts carry a premium. Weekend and holiday shifts are priced accordingly.

factors.label: Regional demand
factors.detail: Rates adjust with real-time coverage availability in your area. High-demand windows are flagged clearly before you confirm.

factors.label: Staff tier
factors.detail: Choose from Pulse (standard), Vetted (top performers), or Veteran (most experienced) depending on your coverage needs.

tiers.name: Pulse
tiers.detail: Qualified, screened professionals who meet all compliance requirements for your request.

tiers.name: Vetted
tiers.detail: Workers with consistently high ratings and positive client feedback across multiple engagements.

tiers.name: Veteran
tiers.detail: Senior professionals with extensive field experience — ideal for complex or high-acuity environments.

staffing.lockNote: Your quoted rate is locked once you confirm coverage. It will not change mid-shift.
staffing.billingSubtitle: Simple, predictable invoicing tied to the shifts you actually use.

steps.label: Request posted
steps.detail: You post a staffing request with your dates, times, and required profession. A live rate quote is generated immediately.

steps.label: Coverage confirmed
steps.detail: Once you confirm, the rate locks in and matched workers are dispatched. Your billing period opens.

steps.label: Shifts completed
steps.detail: Workers check in and out digitally. Timesheets are submitted for your review within your approval window.

steps.label: Invoice generated
steps.detail: At the close of your billing period, a consolidated invoice is issued for all approved shifts — collected via your preferred payment method.

staffing.billingNote: Invoices reflect only approved timesheets. Disputed hours are held until resolved.
staffing.netTermsNote: Net-30 terms available for qualifying organizations.
staffing.surgeExplain: When demand exceeds regional supply, a surge indicator appears on your quote. You can still confirm at the surged rate or adjust your dates.
